x: In the 100 Yards Club Handicap, young Jack Crilly showed a marked improvement on his previous running and won well. He has now developed and with some conscientious training should soon be troubling the judges again.

Haly was placed second and young Jack Crilly third, so the latter thus concluded a very successful season. The 1320 yards Handicap resulted in a win for Harry Shields, and off a liberal mark he led Tom Pritchard and A.
The 200 yards was won by young Jack Crilly, a son of the S.L.H. popular masseur, and he is another of our most promising juniors.
The last championship event of the meeting was the junior furlong for members under 18, and it was the only championship which didn't change hands, for J.
Tosh, J. Crilly, and the proportion of Club members present was very gratifying.
